studio.meta: Explore custom songs and package options at UNAI Music Studio. Orders are not yet available.
studio.lead: A personal song inspired by your story: a creative journey from your idea to the final recording you choose.
studio.status: We are not accepting orders yet. Packages are for information only; purchasing and booking are not available.
studio.clock: A purchase does not start the delivery timeline. The timeline starts at the approved production start time.
studio.revisions: The first production offers two alternatives. Each revision offers two new alternatives; the final delivery is one selected song.
studio.alternativeNote: The package alternative total assumes all included revisions are used. You may select a song sooner.
studio.formats: The one selected song is delivered as MP3; WAV is also provided if technically possible.
studio.rights: A new story or an entirely new song is a separate service. Commercial-use rights are not automatically included.
studio.weekday: On regular working days, 09:00–18:00 is standard. 18:00–24:00 is available only under an approved emergency rate.
studio.holidays: There is no production or delivery from 00:00–09:00. Weekends and public/religious holidays are available only under an approved emergency rate.
